subject: EU data sequestration: onboarding plan & evidence bundle request
messages:
From: Jurgen Schmidt <jurgen.schmidt@novamed.eu>
To: aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Cc: Anna Muller <anna.muller@novamed.eu>
Date: 2028-11-01T09:12:00+01:00
Subject: EU-only processing & VPC requirement - initial questionnaire

Hi Aditya,

Thanks for the demo last week. Legal has a handful of must-haves before we progress: Novamed must ensure that PHI and patient metadata for EU customers is processed and stored only within EU jurisdictions. Specifically:

- A contractual commitment that traffic and persistent storage for EU-account data remain in EU regions (no fallback to non-EU).
- Evidence of infrastructure isolation options (private VPC/private connector, on-prem option).
- Current SOC2 Type II report and completed SIG/CAIQ answers.
- Network diagram showing where egress/ingress is terminated and who has access to KMS.

Can you confirm what parameters you can commit to in a contract (DPA + SCCs) and provide an evidence bundle we can attach to our procurement file? Target: procurement decision by 2028-11-15.

Cc'ing Anna from Legal Operations for scoping.

Best,
Jurgen
Legal Counsel
Novamed GmbH

From: aditya_rao@redwood.ai 
To: Jurgen Schmidt <jurgen.schmidt@novamed.eu>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, priyom_das@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-11-02T10:05:00+01:00
Subject: Re: EU-only processing & VPC requirement - initial questionnaire

Hi Jurgen — appreciate the clear list. Short answers and an onboarding plan below. Attached is a preliminary evidence bundle; happy to walk through live.

1) EU-only processing commitment:
- We can commit contractually (DPA + SCCs) that Novamed tenant data for EU customers is processed only in EU regions. This includes model inputs, outputs, and persisted artifacts for pinned tenant storage. The DPA clause is standard and we can discuss any additional contractual language you need.

2) Deployment options:
- Hosted (region-locked): Redwood Hosted API with region lock to Frankfurt (eu-central-1) or Amsterdam (eu-west-1) and Private Connector to your VPC.
- Dedicated/Private: Dedicated cluster on customer VPC or our Private deployment package for full tenant isolation (options for on-prem if required).

3) Evidence provided (attached):
- Redwood_SOC2_Type2_2027.pdf (controls + SOC attestation)
- Redwood_DPA_Template_v3.docx (includes SCCs annex)
- network-diagram-private-connector.svg (shows flow and egress points)
- SIG-completed-Novamed.xlsx (completed SIG CAIQ answers; outstanding items highlighted)

4) Next steps and timeline:
- Week 1 (by 2028-11-08): provide signed DPA + SCCs redline and final SOC2 artifact delivered.
- Week 2 (by 2028-11-15): technical onboarding call to validate Private Connector and confirm KMS/hsm options.

If you like, we can lock a 45-min call with our security engineer and solutions architect.

Aditya Rao
Senior Account Executive — Europe
Redwood Inference

Subject: Fwd: Novamed evidence bundle - legal redline coordination

Aditya / Priyom — forwarding Jurgen's request and our initial package. Priyom, can you please: 

- Confirm whether the Hosted region-lock + Private Connector wording is sufficient for contractual language (DPA + SCCs), or if we should push for Dedicated/Private as a requirement.
- Prep a short note on key control points: KMS residency, audit logs retention, and access controls for Novamed tenant.

I suggest we offer both a Hosted region-lock (standard for PLG) and a Dedicated plan (SLA and full isolation) as options — highlight tradeoffs on cost and lead time.

Laura Bennett
Director, Enterprise Sales Engineering
Redwood Inference

Hi Jurgen / Anna — Priyom from Solutions Engineering. Quick technical clarifications that will be needed for the onboarding ticket and to finalize the technical annex to the DPA: 

1) Which EU region do you require (Frankfurt / Amsterdam / Paris)?
2) Do you require customer-managed KMS keys (yes/no)? If yes, we will provide instructions for CMEK in the Private Connector/Dedicated plan.
3) Expected QPS and peak concurrency (rough numbers) so we can size Dedicated pool if you request it.

If you prefer, we can run a short discovery call (30 min) to capture these details — we have slots tomorrow 11:00–13:00 CET.

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

From: Jurgen Schmidt <jurgen.schmidt@novamed.eu>
To: aditya_rao@redwood.ai, priyom_das@redwood.ai
Cc: Anna Muller <anna.muller@novamed.eu>
Date: 2028-11-07T11:20:00+01:00
Subject: Re: EU-only processing & VPC requirement - technical clarifications

Thanks, Priyom. Answers below: 

1) Region: Frankfurt preferred (eu-central-1).
2) KMS: yes — customer-managed keys required. We use Azure Key Vault; we will want guidance on key wrapping and your support for BYOK.
3) Load: initial 50 rps average, peaks up to 500 rps for batch processing windows.

We want to review the redlined DPA this week. Procurement target unchanged (2028-11-15). Will you be able to provide the final redline and a short implementation plan by 2028-11-08?

— Jurgen

From: aditya_rao@redwood.ai

Jurgen / Anna — attaching the redline to the DPA and a short implementation plan. TL;DR: we can commit to EU-only processing for tenant data, provide SCCs in the DPA, and support customer-managed keys (BYOK) via our Private Connector / Dedicated options. Implementation plan highlights:

- 2028-11-09: Finalize and sign DPA + SCCs (DocuSign link below).
- 2028-11-10: Kickoff technical onboarding and exchange key material (guide attached).
- 2028-11-14: Staging validation with traffic routed through Private Connector to eu-central-1.
- 2028-11-20: Production cutover (if Dedicated requested, additional provisioning lead time applies).

Attachments sent: Redwood_DPA_Template_v3.docx (redline), network-diagram-private-connector.svg, SIG-completed-Novamed.xlsx, Redwood_SOC2_Type2_2027.pdf.

DocuSign link: https://docusign.com/envelope/ENVELOPE-129384
